title: Ask HN: Is there a marketable "skill" to using AI?
excerpt: Most developers don't have any experience using AI to it's full potential. If only because it's cost prohibitive.
content_html:
Most developers don't have any experience using AI to it's full potential. If only because it's cost prohibitive.

Commanding legions of AI bots to attack problems. The the skills and best practices of using AI as copilot are different than being a Roman emperor managing a civilization and conquest over your enemies.
